text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Without Shiina Frejus in the field, this 
Kikuka Sho is practically a guaranteed win 
for Mr. C.B.~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of performance she'll 
put on in a long-distance race... Ooh, I 
can't wait for the start!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally here. S-cchi and 
C.B.-san's final big showdown, the 'Kikuka 
Sho'...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Distance-wise, people say CB-chan has the 
advantage... but I just know...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—At last, it's the final match of the 
best-of-three.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Katsuragi Ace stares toward what lies 
ahead, her eyes hold a fiery determination 
stronger than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To me, that felt somehow slightly... 
strained."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I'm alright, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
My heart is burning intensely with 
ambition, yet I feel amazingly calm. 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's right here. The power to believe in 
everything I've done so far, given to me 
by Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And today... I'm carrying the feelings of 
someone I truly respect right here.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I'll never run a half-hearted race.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely win and shatter all common 
sense...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's powerful words made me 
feel as if she were the one giving me 
courage instead. If that's the case, then 
all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Believing in her, high-fiving our right 
hands together, all I can do is send her 
off...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Now, it's time for rep three. Are you 
ready for this, C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
…………Ace, did something about your vibe 
change?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I just renewed my resolve. That I'm 
definitely going to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You're even more passionate than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...That's got me all fired up too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's get started. Our... 
greatest 'Kikuka Sho'."
